definitions.gloss: nut (the metal fastener that screws onto a bolt)
definitions.explanation: The threaded fastener that pairs with a bolt to clamp parts together. Loanword from English 'nut'. Not to be confused with the food {納豆|なっとう} (fermented soybeans) or with nuts as in {木|き}の{実|み}.

examples.japanese: ナット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{締|し}める→締める：10057_shimeru⟧。
⟦ボルト→ボルト：23094_boruto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ナット⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{固定|こてい}した→固定する：19647_koteisuru⟧。
examples.english: I fastened the parts together with a bolt and nut.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緩|ゆる}んでいる→緩む：10056_yurumu⟧ナット⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦レンチ→レンチ：05600_renchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked one by one with a wrench to see if there were any loose nuts.

notes:
Loanword from English "nut" (fastener). Used in mechanical, construction, and DIY contexts. Pronounced and written with a small っ — distinct from ⟦{納豆|なっとう}→納豆：04930_nattou⟧, which has a long final vowel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ナット⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{締|し}める→締める：10057_shimeru⟧ / ⟦{緩|ゆる}める→緩める：15263_yurumeru⟧: to tighten / loosen a nut
- ⟦ボルト→ボルト：23094_boruto⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ナット: bolt and nut
- ナット⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧: the nut comes off
- ⟦{六角|ろっかく}→六角：26702_rokkaku⟧ナット: hex nut

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ボルト→ボルト：23094_boruto⟧: bolt — the threaded fastener that the nut screws onto
- ⟦ねじ→ねじ：00307_neji⟧: screw — broader term, includes both bolts and small wood/metal screws
- ワッシャー: washer — flat ring placed under a nut or bolt head
